what: robustness_v6 reruns, before and after the four kernel corrections
harness: robustness_v6_ported.py -- ported from Monte Carlo/robustness_v6.py with exactly two differences (_PROD_CANDIDATES, CSV_DEFAULT), proved by whole-module AST diff: 748 normalised lines each side, 2 hunks.

before.validation: reproduces the SHIPPED 2026-07-01 outputs in Monte Carlo/robustness_out/ BYTE FOR BYTE for trimming and ar1; power reproduces the ORIGINAL file byte for byte under identical args

after.anchor_csv: cbar_surface_corrected.csv built from the 427 const cells (2026-08-09 run, C1-banked) and the 206 banked maic cells
after.maic_gate: F1a PASSED on (m=2,T=300); F1b still owed before ingestion

conventions.ar1: R_ANCHOR_CV=R_ANCHOR_POW=8000, R_EVAL=10000, R_RECAL_CV=R_RECAL_POW=4000, SEED_BASE=20260624, rho in {0.3,0.5,0.6}, m in {0,1,2}, T in {30,60,100}. tab:ar1-sizepower is the rho=0.5 slice. Reads pt (tuple index 3), so it does NOT carry correction 2.
conventions.trimming: R_CV=10000, R_POW=5000, SEED0=90909, eps in {0.1,0.15,0.2}. Reads pt, so it does NOT carry correction 2.
conventions.power: T=60, m=2, lambda=(1/3,2/3), R=10000, SEED_BASE=20260701, C_ALT=-10, BETA_BIG=50. Reads mzt (index 2), so it DOES carry correction 2.
conventions.power_new_anchor: same, with SPECS[0] = -9.6975 overridden AT RUNTIME from a wrapper so the port keeps its two-difference guarantee.
conventions.lambda_third_cell: m=2, T=60, lambda=(1/3,2/3) EXACTLY, const, R_cv=R_pow=200000, break positions [20,40]. cbar* = -9.6975 +- 0.0203, poder_star = 0.5 (root), fallback_used = False.

se_note: se of a proportion: 0.005 at p=0.05 with R=10000; 0.002 at p=0.05 with R_EVAL=10000 over the size cells; 0.005 at p=0.5.
